review_note: Operator: the Stevens Memorial Museum 'is the centerpiece of the John Hay Center, founded by the Washington County Historical Society', at 307 E. Market Street, Salem. Overture society and Stevens records share that street, johnhaycenter.org and 812-883-6495; IMLS society EIN 356063713 uses the same street and website. Count the named museum once and retain the society rows as same-site support. The Depot Railroad Museum is a separately named John Hay Center site and is not merged. The operator's preferred umbrella name is John Hay Center. Governance: the operator lists its own elected WCHS board and officers, with no county or other parent operator; IRS lists a 501(c)(3). Operator hours are posted for 2026. Complete factual review; this is not a field survey of the map point.
